expected_root_cause: The node kind-control-plane has a NoSchedule taint (scenario.kubernaut.io/dedicated=true:NoSchedule) and the pod does not have a matching toleration, so the scheduler refuses to place it there and it stays Pending.
key_evidence: A FailedScheduling event on the pod mentioning the taint or 'node(s) had untolerated taint'
The node's taints field (from get_node_conditions) showing the scenario.kubernaut.io/dedicated NoSchedule taint
The pod spec has no matching toleration
